name: materialize-intermediate-findings-workflow
description: Workflow variant of materialize-intermediate-findings. Uses two-phase enforcement (Method #15) to force the agent to investigate and document findings in Phase 1, then correlate and produce the final report in Phase 2. Phase 1 reads error logs and writes intermediate analysis to workspace files. Phase 2 reads Phase 1 artifacts plus remaining data, then produces the root-cause report. This prevents the common failure mode of batching all writes to the end.
